    bp = P(p.x // k, p.y // k)
    sp = P(p.x % k, p.y % k)
    ret = []
    if (bp.x + bp.y) % 2 == 0:
        ret.append([P(bp.x, bp.y + 1), k - sp.y])
        ret.append([P(bp.x, bp.y - 1), sp.y + 1])
        ret.append([P(bp.x + 1, bp.y), k - sp.x])
        ret.append([P(bp.x - 1, bp.y), sp.x + 1]) # Corrected the toll calculation for movement in the x-direction.

        ret.append([bp, 0])
    return ret
